title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight
abstract: arXiv:2608.23941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: rejecting everything catches everything. Measuring this needs boundary variation alone and a matched clean control. We introduce the twin-prefix framework, which supplies both. Each gold plan yields a prefix with one injected, environment-accepted error and a clean twin differing in one write. Judging each pair at five nested lengths ties verdict changes to the unit alone. Discrimination is scored by pre-registered informedness, catch minus false re

translated_title: 更排斥而非更具辨别力：预执行LLM监督中的验证单元
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23941v1 公告类型：新 摘要：预执行监督是AI控制中可信监控的核心：一个可能出错的LLM监控器在不可逆执行前审查计划行动。过度拦截会损害实用性，并迫使部署者禁用该机制。每个协议必须固定一个验证单元：一次调用审查多少行动。现有设计将单元视为给定；其对易错监控器的影响未被测量。自然轨迹无法隔离该影响：审查长度与错误类型和位置共变。仅凭捕获率会误导：拒绝一切会捕获一切。测量此影响需要仅边界变化和匹配的干净对照。我们引入了双前缀框架，提供两者。每个黄金计划生成一个带有注入的、环境接受错误的前缀，以及一个仅在一个写入上不同的干净孪生。在五个嵌套长度上评判每对，将判定变化仅与单元绑定。辨别力通过预注册的信息性评分，即捕获率减去误拒率来衡量。
tldr: 本文提出双前缀框架，通过匹配的干净对照和边界变化，首次隔离并测量预执行LLM监督中验证单元对辨别力的影响，发现更排斥而非更辨别。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the twin-prefix framework to isolate and measure the effect of verification unit size on pre-execution LLM oversight, revealing that larger units increase rejection rather than discrimination.
